Hi Sam —

Thanks again for a productive demo yesterday. As promised, I pulled together a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) plus a lightweight Week‑0 playbook so your team has a clear path to the evaluation milestones we discussed. The docs are intentionally narrow — focused on technical readiness, acceptance criteria, and the 30/60/90 decision checkpoints.

What I attached/shared below:
- redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc — editable MAP (owner: Redwood / co‑owner: Skylark)
- week0-playbook-slide-deck.gslides — 10‑slide facilitator guide for the kickoff workshop
- week0-readiness-checklist.xlsx — ops checklist (SSO, sample data, firewall rules)

As a next step, can you:
1) Confirm who from Skylark should be the primary MAP owner (would love the name + mobile)
2) Share availability for a 60‑minute Week‑0 kickoff next week (I suggested two slots below)
3) Call out any must‑have security or procurement items up front so we can surface them in the MAP

Suggested kickoff windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 6 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Oct 7 — 14:00–15:00

I’ll seed the MAP with the milestones we discussed and mark tentative owners. Once we lock the kickoff, Kimberly will lead the technical runbook review and Ben will own commercial acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
